description: Missing singular article insertion (Step 5 / L4). Rule en-l4-missing-singular-article inserts a/an before a whitelisted singular count noun (apple/bicycle/book/hat/orange/student/teacher) after a verb like want/need/buy/bought, choosing 'an' before a vowel-initial noun. Expectations encode the VERIFIED behaviour of correctWithTutorRules() on current main.
fp_risk_note: Article insertion must stay scoped to the whitelisted count nouns and must not guess elsewhere. The negative cases stress: (1) sentences that already have the article ('I want an apple') — re-inserting would double it; (2) uncountable / non-whitelisted nouns ('water') where no article should be added; (3) non-noun complements ('He is happy') where 'happy' is an adjective, not a count noun. Note: copula+profession ('He is teacher' -> 'He is a teacher') is handled by a DIFFERENT rule (en-step6-profession-article) and is intentionally NOT covered here.

positive.notes: Vowel-initial noun -> 'an' (want apple -> want an apple).
